game.q: yama throws his rope anyway, and it catches the stone too. what happens?

wrong.snap: dramatic, yes. but the rope held.

game.right: YES. he never let go, and the one he held on to came to him.

end.line: he was told sixteen was the end. he held on, and it wasn’t.
end.l2: he held on, and fate lost.
